en: A black-and-white vintage street scene showing a broad urban street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops on both sides. People are walking and cycling along the road, and several early 20th‑century vehicles are visible in the distance. A tall church spire rises in the background, and on the right side of the image a prominent tower with patterned brickwork can be seen. At the bottom right, caption text reads "NIJMEGEN. MOLENSTRAAT" indicating the location.
